body.name: Ordered target-shell selector
body.construction: At resolution \(r\), use \(t_P\) and \(\mathcal S_m(P;r)\) on \(\mathcal G_r\), define \(\mathfrak W_r(Q)\) as displayed in the symbol table, and release \(T_{\mathrm{shell}}\) with conditional probabilities proportional to \(\exp\{-\epsilon Q_t(D_n)/2\}\).
